title: DDLS Research School opens its Affiliate Program for PhD students
summary: The DDLS Research School is now open to PhD students who are not funded by DDLS. The new Affiliate Program is for students with a suitable research profile who started their PhD on or after 1 October 2025. Applications are open until 30 November, and up to 15 students will be admitted. They will join the Research School in 2027, starting with the DDLS Research School Annual Meeting on 16–19 March 2027.
